per_row: N=128 (legs 1, 2, 3): fitted and evaluated on the local Apple-silicon Mac, JAX CPU backend (JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu, arm64).
N=256 (legs 1, 2, 3): fitted and evaluated on the local Apple-silicon Mac, JAX CPU backend (JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu, arm64).
N=512 (legs 1, 2, 3): fitted and evaluated on RunPod pod c1h12kov47rcm4, NVIDIA A40, JAX CUDA backend (JAX_PLATFORMS=cuda, x86_64).
note: The N=512 row is a declared runtime departure: the local CPU driver needed roughly ten minutes per fit at that grid, so the twenty N=512 fits and their evaluations were moved to a rented A40 under the CUDA backend. Package pins (jax/jaxlib 0.8.1, exponax 0.2.0, equinox 0.13.8), model, optimiser, schedule, seeds, corpus generator, metric and gate thresholds are identical to the CPU rows; only the XLA backend and the host differ. Both arms of every cell share one runtime, so no narrow-versus-broad contrast spans backends. Four N=512 narrow seeds fitted earlier on CPU were refitted on the pod rather than mixed into the row; the originals are preserved under results/preserved_cpu_partial/.
